```plato

// A pinhole perspective camera defined by a vertical field of view.
// AspectRatio is image width over height; the horizontal field of view follows
// from VerticalFov and AspectRatio.
// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinhole_camera_model and
// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Perspective_projection.
type PerspectiveCamera
    implements ICamera
{
    Pose: Pose3D;
    VerticalFov: Angle;
    AspectRatio: Number;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}
```
